intro: The news feeds, calendars and sentiment Atlas reads, and whether each one is working.

note.exchange: Listings, delistings and maintenance notices from OKX.
note.crypto_news: Atlas links each headline to the coins it mentions.
note.markets_news: Company and macro news for stock, ETF and commodity perps.
note.calendar: Releases scheduled for the next 48 hours. ForexFactory is the default; Finnhub replaces it while its key works.
note.earnings: Report dates and results for the companies behind your stock perps.
note.sentiment: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index, once an hour.

d.standby: <n>{{provider}}</n> provides the calendar while its key works

strip.label: {{headlines}} in the last 24 hours, the newest at {{time}}.
strip.none: No headlines in the last 24 hours.

sum.firstRun: Atlas hasn’t checked any source yet

sub.noHeadlines: No headlines in the last 24 hours.
sub.firstRun: The first checks run within 2 minutes of Atlas starting.
sub.stalled: No source has been checked for {{mins}}. Check that Atlas is running with <cmd>./atlas up</cmd>.
sub.allOff: Atlas isn’t reading any news. Turn on the sources you want below.

chart.title: Headlines in the last 24 hours
chart.empty: Headlines appear here as they arrive.
chart.label: Headlines per hour over the last 24 hours. Use the arrow keys to read each hour.

down.crypto_news: No crypto news is coming in
down.markets_news: No markets news is coming in

until.crypto_news: Until one works, Atlas has no crypto headlines.
until.markets_news: Until one works, Atlas has no markets headlines.
until.calendar: Until one works, Atlas can’t see scheduled releases.

sw.label: Use {{name}}
sw.needsKey: Add a key to turn on {{name}}
sw.failBody: Atlas’s server didn’t answer, so nothing changed. Try again.

limitedToast: Too many changes. Try again in a minute.

loadError.title: Couldn’t load the data sources
loadError.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with <cmd>./atlas up</cmd>, then try again.

empty.title: No data sources yet
empty.body: Atlas adds its news, calendar and sentiment sources the first time it starts. Restart Atlas with <cmd>./atlas up</cmd>, then try again.
